falsification_conditions.condition: The S&P 500 index closes above 5,200 on at least 3 consecutive trading days within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would indicate strong bullish momentum, contradicting the current HOLD signal and suggesting a potential blowoff top rather than a continuation of the bottoming pattern.

falsification_conditions.condition: The 20-day moving average of the VIX (Volatility Index) drops below 12 within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A significant decline in volatility would suggest reduced fear in the market, which could invalidate the current HOLD signal by indicating a shift toward bullish sentiment and a potential end to the bottoming phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: The number of new highs on the NYSE exceeds 150 in a single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would indicate a broad market rally, which would contradict the current HOLD signal and suggest that the market is moving away from the bottoming pattern and toward a new uptrend.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
